# Release Notes / 发行说明

> **中文**：本目录是**每个迭代版本的双语发行说明**（问题 + 改变），也是 GitHub Release 正文的**唯一来源**。
> **English**: This directory holds the **bilingual release notes** (the problem + what changed) for every
> version. It is the **single source** for the GitHub Release body.

## 为什么要有这个目录 / Why this exists

**中文**：GitHub Release 的正文此前由 `.github/workflows/release.yml` 的 `--generate-notes` 自动生成，
结果有的版本只剩一行 `**Full Changelog**` 链接 —— 下载的人看不到「上一版出了什么问题、这一版改了什么」。
更糟的是全部只有中文。现在规则改了：**没有对应说明文件的 tag 不允许发版**（CI 会失败并告诉你缺哪个文件）。

**English**: Release bodies used to be auto-generated by `--generate-notes`, which left some versions with
nothing but a `**Full Changelog**` link — a downloader could not see what problem the previous version had or
what this one changed. All of it was Chinese-only. The rule is now: **a tag with no notes file cannot be
released** (CI fails and tells you which file is missing).

## 每个版本必须回答两个问题 / Every version must answer two questions

1. **出了什么问题**（为什么要有这一版）—— 不是"新增了哪些功能"，而是**上一版缺什么、哪里会出错、谁受影响**。
2. **改变了什么** —— 具体到可验证的行为，并附上验证方式。

1. **What problem existed** (why this version exists) — not "what features were added", but *what was missing,
   what could go wrong, and who was affected*.
2. **What changed** — concrete, checkable behaviour, plus how it was verified.

## 文件命名与用法 / Naming and usage

| 文件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `vX.Y.Z.md` | 该 tag 的发行说明。发布工作流按 `${GITHUB_REF_NAME}` 直接取用 |
| `TEMPLATE.md` | 新版本从这里开始写；中英两段都要有 |
| `README.md` | 本文件（索引与规则） |

```bash
# 发布工作流做的事（本地可复现）
gh release edit v0.3.0 --notes-file docs/release-notes/v0.3.0.md
gh release create v0.4.0 --notes-file docs/release-notes/v0.4.0.md --prerelease
```
